Agent Name: Product Manager
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Product Manager incorrectly assigned the role of "Engineer" to themselves, leading them to implement the knapsack function logic instead of creating a Product Requirement Document (PRD) as instructed. This fundamental role confusion caused the creation of an incorrect file structure and content, which propagated errors to all subsequent steps and made recovery impossible.
